title: Tension in OA
description: Essential: Correctly calculates tension in rope OA as m_A * g = 50 N.

title: Tension in OB
description: Important: Recognizes that tension in OB equals tension in OA due to equilibrium at knot O.

title: Tension in OP
description: Essential: Correctly computes tension in OP using vector addition (Pythagorean theorem) to get 50√2 N.

title: Friction on B
description: Essential: Correctly identifies static friction on B equals tension in OB (50 N) for equilibrium.

title: Force equilibrium at knot
description: Important: Applies equilibrium conditions at point O, resolving forces horizontally and vertically.

title: Angle consideration
description: Optional: Mentions that the 45° angle ensures equal horizontal/vertical components from OP at O.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (N) throughout calculations.

title: Incorrect vector resolution
description: Pitfall: Misapplies angle (e.g., uses 45° incorrectly for OP components) or omits vector addition.

title: Forgetting friction direction
description: Pitfall: Fails to recognize friction opposes tension in OB or assigns wrong sign.
